title: DSH Prompt Structure
description: Common standard for prompts sent to DSH (DeepSeek Harness) agent sessions. All ADLC prompt generators (blueprint, task, review, etc.) MUST produce a payload that conforms to this schema before rendering it into the final user message.

role.description: The agent persona / role description (e.g. 'ADLC blueprint planner', 'ADLC code reviewer').

objective.description: The primary task the agent must accomplish. This is the user-facing requirement.

instructions.description: Optional extra instructions or constraints from the caller.

context.description: Structured context the agent needs to complete the objective.

current_state.description: Snapshot of the current state the agent is operating on (e.g. existing blueprint stages, current code, current review).

catalogues.description: Catalogues of available items the agent may reference (e.g. node packages, tools, skills).

inputs.description: Named inputs the agent should use (e.g. requirement, source_patch, test_results).

constraints.description: Hard constraints the agent must respect (e.g. allowed package versions, forbidden actions).

metadata.description: Free-form metadata (correlation ids, attempt ids, etc.).

reply_contract.description: Defines the exact shape of the agent's reply so the caller can parse it deterministically.

format.description: How the agent must structure its reply.

summary_required.description: Whether the agent must include a short summary before the structured payload.

files.description: File blocks the agent must include in its reply (using <adlc:file path='...'>...</adlc:file>).

path.description: Logical path of the file inside the reply (e.g. 'blueprint.json', 'review.json').

format.description: Expected content format of the file block.

schema_ref.description: Optional reference to a JSON schema the file content must conform to.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this file should contain.

rules.description: Free-form rules the agent must follow when producing the reply.
